rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for a very strong or powerful person or thing, and it can also praise an impressive achievement.

example.english: That engine is mighty; it can pull such a heavy lorry uphill.
example.traditional: 嗰副引擎真係勁，咁重架貨車都拉得上斜。
example.jyutping: go2 fu3 jan5 king4 zan1 hai6 ging6 gam3 cung5 gaa3 fo3 ce1 dou1 laai1 dak1 soeng5 ce3

rows.note: Use this for something exceptionally large or hefty, rather than for strength or achievement.

example.english: That watermelon you bought is mighty big!
example.traditional: 你買咗個好大嘅西瓜喎！
example.jyutping: nei5 maai5 zo2 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 sai1 gwaa1 wo3

rows.note: Use this when “mighty” means extraordinary or wonderful, especially in praise of a person’s achievement or work.

example.english: It’s mighty impressive that you fixed the air conditioner all by yourself!
example.traditional: 你一個人整好部冷氣，真係了不起呀！
example.jyutping: nei5 jat1 go3 jan4 zing2 hou2 bou6 laang5 hei3 zan1 hai6 liu5 bat1 hei2 aa1
